injuries.name: Jordan Greenway
injuries.note: It wasn't clear prior to the game if he was hurt or simply scratched. Greenway can be considered day-to-day heading into the Blackhawks' upcoming back-to-back set, which begins at home versus the Wild on Sunday.

injuries.name: Tyler Bertuzzi
injuries.note: out

injuries.name: Patrick Kane
injuries.note: Kane blocked a shot late in Wednesday's 3-1 win over Seattle. He will miss at least the next three games, starting with Friday's matchup against the Rangers. However, it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Kane has registered two goals, 16 assists, 47 shots on net, 11 blocked shots and 11 hits in 22 appearances this season.

injuries.name: Connor Bedard
injuries.note: Bedard and the Blackhawks elected to go the surgical route rather than rehabbing with respect to the 21-year-old's shoulder injury, and his recovery timeline has now come into focus. The 2023 No. 1 overall pick was placed on injured reserve Sunday, which freed up a roster spot for the team. Roman Kantserov has been centering the top line of late, and he looked good in that role with six points over the weekend in games against Calgary and Vancouver, so he could be the biggest beneficiary of Bedard's absence.

injuries.name: Wyatt Kaiser
injuries.note: Kaiser won't be eligible to return until Chicago hosts Minnesota on Nov. 29. He has contributed two goals, five assists, 19 shots on net, 30 blocked shots and 20 hits in 23 appearances this season. With Kaiser unavailable, Kevin Korchinski will likely play against Vancouver on Sunday.

injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: Byram was previously ruled out for Saturday's matchup against Calgary, and he won't be available for Sunday's matchup against Vancouver. It's also doubtful that he will join the team for Wednesday's contest against Seattle. It remains unclear when he will be ready to return.

injuries.name: Gabe Perreault
injuries.note: Perreault is expected to miss the next 4-6 weeks, so it's not surprising to see the Rangers move him to IR. He has seven goals and 11 points in 24 appearances in 2026-27. Jaroslav Chmelar might serve in a middle-six capacity while the Rangers are missing Perreault.

injuries.name: Pavel Dorofeyev
injuries.note: Dorofeyev's status against the Sabres and Blackhawks on Wednesday and Friday, respectively, remains up in the air, but the fact that he is making the trip is certainly a step in the right direction. The 26-year-old winger has notched four goals and four assists, including a trio of power-play points, in his last 11 outings. Once given the all-clear, Dorofeyev should reclaim a middle-six role with the Rangers.

injuries.name: Oliver Bjorkstrand
injuries.note: Bjorkstrand landed on injured reserve Friday due to his upper-body injury, which has been revealed to keep him sidelined for the foreseeable future. Prior to going down, the 31-year-old winger compiled seven goals, 11 points, a plus-2 rating, 30 shots on net and 14 hits over 22 appearances. His current timetable for return should get him back in the mix around late January or early February. In the meantime, Matt Rempe will likely see more consistent playing time moving forward.

injuries.name: Alberts Smits
injuries.note: Smits landed on injured reserve in early November, which has caused him to miss the Rangers' last five games. The 18-year-old blueliner appeared in 17 contests prior to going down, where posted a minus-2 rating, eight shots on net, 16 hits and 10 blocked shots while averaging 14:29 of ice time. Given his current time line, he's expected to return sometime between late January and March. In his absence, Matthew Robertson and Scott Morrow should continue to see depth roles on the blue line.

injuries.name: Joe Veleno
injuries.note: Although Veleno didn't participate in practice Friday, it was encouraging to see him on the ice ahead of the session. The 26-year-old has been on long-term injured reserve since early October, and he was initially expected to miss approximately three months, so it wouldn't be surprising to see the Rangers bring him along slowly as he continues his recovery process.

injuries.name: Igor Shesterkin
injuries.note: Shesterkin was hurt during Friday's game against the Capitals when his right leg got jammed into the post while returning to the crease on a scrambled play, and the Rangers ruled him out for the season a day later. He was placed on injured reserve Sunday, and the team has now provided some clarification on the exact nature of his injury. Dylan Garand is slated to serve as the Rangers' No. 1 option in the crease until Joonas Korpisalo (lower body) is back in action.

injuries.name: Connor Bedard
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Chicago Blackhawks said on Monday (Nov. 23) that Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months.

injuries.name: Tyler Bertuzzi
injuries.note: Illness: Bertuzzi did not play in Wednesday's (Nov. 25) game versus the Kraken.

injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Chicago Blackhawks said on Saturday (Nov. 21) that Byram didn't accompany his teammates on the team's three-game road trip, per Mark Lazerus of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Ryan Ellis
injuries.note: Back: The Chicago Blackhawks placed D Ryan Ellis on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Jordan Greenway
injuries.note: Upper Body: Greenway missed Friday's (Nov. 27) game versus the Rangers due to an upper-body injury, Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

injuries.name: Patrick Kane
injuries.note: Foot: The Chicago Blackhawks placed F Patrick Kane on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Oliver Bjorkstrand
injuries.note: Upper Body: The New York Rangers said on Saturday (Nov. 21) that Bjorkstrand is expected to be sidelined for 2-3 months, per Peter Baugh of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Pavel Dorofeyev
injuries.note: Lower Body: The New York Rangers said on Tuesday (Nov. 24) that Dorofeyev will join the team for its two-game road trip, per Mollie Walker of the New York Post.

injuries.name: Gabe Perreault
injuries.note: Lower Body: The New York Rangers placed F Gabe Perreault on injured reserve and is OUT for 4-6 weeks as of Thursday (Nov. 26).

injuries.name: Igor Shesterkin
injuries.note: Lower Body: The New York Rangers placed G Igor Shesterkin on Long-Term Injured Reserve.

injuries.name: Alberts Smits
injuries.note: Upper Body: The New York Rangers said on Saturday (Nov. 21) that Smits will miss 2-to-3 months.

injuries.name: Adam Sykora
injuries.note: Lower-body: The New York Rangers placed F Adam Sykora on injured reserve on Monday (Sept. 28).

injuries.name: Aidan Thompson
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The New York Rangers placed F Aidan Thompson on injured reserve on Wednesday (Sep. 16).

injuries.name: Joseph Veleno
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The New York Rangers said that Veleno skated on his own before Friday's (Nov. 20) practice session, per Colin Stephenson of Newsday.
